name: bg-animate-button

frames.best_why: All three gradient pills sit unobstructed, showing orange, pale blue and violet fills.

tagline: Pill buttons whose orange, blue and violet fills slowly turn.
summary: Three rounded pill buttons sit on black, filled with turning orange, pale blue and violet gradients. The colour sweeps around inside each pill while the bold label stays still.
appearance: Three rounded pill buttons sit in a row on black, one orange-red, one pale blue and one violet, each darker toward its edges. Labels are bold dark text, except on the violet pill where it is white.
behaviour: Each pill's conic gradient turns slowly inside the frame, so light sweeps around it while the shape and label hold still. The three run at their own speeds.
demo_content: Three buttons labelled Get Started, Explore and Continue.
search_phrases: button with a spinning gradient background
colorful rounded call to action buttons
bright gradient buttons for a hero
use_when: A hero needs bright, colourful calls to action that stand out on a dark background.
avoid_when: Light fills force dark label text, and each colour is a fixed preset rather than a free colour.
customise: The label comes in as children; gradient preset, animation speed, rounding, size and shadow are props. A new colour needs a new preset in the source.
weight_why: Three CSS spin animations on gradient spans; no script and no canvas.

a11y.note: Native buttons keep their focus ring, but the spin never pauses for reduced-motion users.

issues: The variant prop is accepted but never used, so changing it has no effect.
polish_why: Bright, evenly rounded pills with a smooth turning fill; the presets are only colour swaps.
title: Animated Gradient Button
